title: Twisted Bracelets for Sorting by Transpositions: the Transposition Diameter of $S_{16}$
summary: Sorting By Transpositions (SBT) seeks the minimum number of transpositions required to sort a permutation $π$ on $n$ symbols into the identity $ι$. Let $N=n+1$. A cyclic-target pair $(ω,β)$ consists of an even permutation $ω$ and an $N$-cycle $β$ for which $ρ=ωβ$ is an $N$-cycle. An SBT instance is the special case $(\barι{\barπ}^{-1},\barπ)$, where $\barπ$ and $\barι$ encode $π$ and $ι$, and $\barι{\barπ}^{-1}\barπ=\barι$.
